scope: Schema constraints + indexes + N+1 + append-only enforcement + CHECK validation
evidence_method: MySQL information_schema introspection + migration Read + Eloquent boot/booted handlers

findings.title: stock_movements_idempotency_unique UNIQUE constraint EXISTS on idempotency_key
findings.evidence: SHOW INDEX FROM stock_movements returns 'stock_movements_idempotency_unique non-unique=0'. Verified MySQL prod schema. tests/Feature/Stock/StockMovementsAppendOnlyTest::test_stock_movement_idempotency_key_is_unique_when_present asserts QueryException on duplicate insert (passing).

findings.title: stock_levels_branch_stockable_unique UNIQUE constraint exists
findings.evidence: Composite UNIQUE (branch_id, stockable_type, stockable_id) confirmed via SHOW INDEX. Prevents duplicate per-branch stock-of-thing rows.

findings.title: stock_levels CHECK constraints (on_hand>=0, reserved>=0, reserved<=on_hand) ACTIVE on MySQL prod
findings.evidence: TABLE_CONSTRAINTS query returns CHECK: stock_levels_on_hand_non_negative, stock_levels_reserved_lte_on_hand, stock_levels_reserved_non_negative. App-level guard at StockLevel.php:66-74 mirrors. Triple defense: app + DB CHECK + atomic transaction.

findings.title: stock_movements append-only enforced at Eloquent level only (no DB BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger)
findings.evidence: static::updating and static::deleting throw LogicException. NO MySQL trigger. Direct UPDATE/DELETE via DB::statement bypasses Eloquent. Compared to audit_logs (fiscal frozen) which has DB triggers per CLAUDE.md §8. Stock is NOT NF525-critical and append-only is best-effort — this is intentional design difference.
findings.verdict: ACCEPTABLE — stock_movements append-only is operational invariant, not legal. App-level guard adequate.
findings.scope_minimal_heal: Defer DB trigger to V1.0.2 hardening.

findings.title: lowAlerts query — index coverage on (branch_id, on_hand, threshold_low) NOT present
findings.evidence: whereIn('branch_id', $branchIds)->whereNotNull('threshold_low')->whereColumn('on_hand','<=','threshold_low')->orderBy('branch_id')->orderBy('on_hand')->limit(200). Indexes available: stock_levels_branch_stockable_unique (composite) + stock_levels_stockable_idx. No index on threshold_low. With low row count (one row per stockable_type/id/branch, capped at thousands), query plan via PRIMARY+filesort acceptable for limit 200. N+1 absent (single query).
findings.verdict: ACCEPTABLE — low volume, limit 200 bound, no perf hot path.
findings.scope_minimal_heal: Defer composite index (branch_id, threshold_low, on_hand) to V1.0.2 if rupture row count grows.

findings.title: lastSummary potential N+1 via item:id,name + branch:id,name eager load
findings.evidence: with(['item:id,name', 'branch:id,name']) explicit selective eager load. Limit 100. Single query + 2 IN-list resolved relations. NOT N+1.
